name: Saxion University of Applied Sciences
overview:
Saxion University of Applied Sciences is a University of Applied Sciences that originated from the rich educational history of the city of books Deventer and from the social initiatives of enterprising textile traders from Twente.

Ever since the 13th century, Deventer has been a bastion of books and knowledge. The roots of Saxion University can be traced back to 1875.

A merger of two educational institutions, the Hogeschool Enschede and Hogeschool IJselland, in 1998 paved the way for Saxion University in its present form. This merger enabled Saxion to build further on its bold position in Dutch higher education and since then Saxion University has come to be recognised as an important center of expertise at regional, national and international level.

It provides more than 100 courses in study fields as archaeology, finance, law, engineering, hospitality, business, IT, broadcasting, health and digital media.

The university has more than 27,000 students over its three campuses, with more than 3,500 international students from 89 different nationalities.

Saxion is one of the largest institutions of higher education in the Netherlands.
administrative:
1) Application dossier

Once the IR office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application. All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline).

If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet, please be patient.

To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier


2) Visa

For European students, a valid passport/ national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception for the UK).

For non-Europeans students or students with a non-European citizenship, please check the immigration office of the host country to check the visa process and fees.

Students in France can use this website:

https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/


3) Insurance

For European students

The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM in French) is nominative and individual. This card certifies your rights to the Health Insurance in Europe.

To obtain your card, log in to your Ameli account at least two months before your departure. It is free of charge and will be sent to your place within two weeks. You can also download it online.

For more information:

https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger

For non-European students

You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay.

Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more information depending on the wanted coverage.



Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake…) in your host country for French citizens only:

https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html
accomodation:
Education at Saxion is centered around helping students to develop professional competences. 

All our campuses are fully equipped to support your learning process. From campus-wide wireless internet to quiet places to study - our campuses have it all!

Every school has its own learning resource centre equipped with computers and rooms for working on projects with your fellow students.

Also, students on our creative programmes have access to our fully equipped sound and film studios.

You can find all the information on the campus and student life here. 


https://www.saxion.edu/studying-in-the-netherlands/housing
courses:
30 ECTS per semester

60 ECTS per year


At Saxion University of Applied Sciences, you will attend the courses of the program "Creative Media and Game Technologies".


The programme is divided into 3 parts:

  • Designer
  • Engineer
  • Artist

You can take modules from the second year of study, with a preference for modules under the Designer and Artist parts.


Important Notes

  • Attendance in class is compulsory.
  • The courses are most likely more academic than at Epitech.
  • The course list is given to you for information.
  • It can change from year to year.
  • If a course is not available when you arrive, EPITECH cannot be held responsible for it.
